consumer.name: ConsumerApp
consumer.usage: Shoppers: browse, order, pay, loyalty. Flagship — its gradient is the master brand gradient.

delivery.name: DeliveryApp
delivery.usage: Riders: pickups, routes, proof of delivery

fade.spec: opacity only — tooltips, toasts out, swaps

pageEnter.spec: slide 24px + fade in; platform-native push on iOS/Android

sheetEnter.spec: bottom sheet / dialog rises from 100% → 0, scrim fades to 48%

success.spec: payment success: circle scales 0.6→1 (bouncy), check stroke draws, coral sparks burst once

skeleton.spec: left→right sheen, infinite; replaced by content with fade

numberTick.spec: amounts/balances count to new value, tabular figures

motion.reducedMotion: When the OS requests reduced motion: replace slides/scales with opacity fades ≤150ms, disable shimmer (static placeholder), disable sparks and number ticks.
